purpose: Immutable self-scoped idempotency receipt for one governed B02-C Schedule placement revision; it binds the exact expected and produced MaterialStateRef while keeping operation identity separate from Schedule and MaterialState identity.

columns.name: self_person_ref
columns.meaning: Authenticated self Person scope owning the revision receipt.

columns.name: operation_id
columns.meaning: Client/application identity for idempotent revision replay.

columns.name: intent_fingerprint
columns.meaning: Deterministic fingerprint of ScheduleRef, exact expected state and requested placement.

columns.name: schedule_ref
columns.meaning: Stable Schedule owner revised by the operation.
columns.value_contract: References the existing Schedule; revision never creates another Schedule.

columns.name: expected_material_state_ref
columns.meaning: Exact placement MaterialStateRef that had to be current for the accepted revision.
columns.value_contract: References schedule_placement_state and is compared to the explicit current binding.

columns.name: material_state_ref
columns.meaning: New immutable placement MaterialStateRef produced by the accepted revision.
columns.value_contract: Application-issued UUIDv7 and unique per receipt.

columns.name: created_at
columns.meaning: Authoritative instant shared with the new current-history episode.
columns.value_contract: Recorded inside the bounded database capability.

primary_key.name: pk_schedule_revision_operation
primary_key.reason: One immutable receipt per self-scoped operation identity.

foreign_keys.name: fk_schedule_revision_operation_self_person_ref_person
foreign_keys.semantic_reason: Bind operation scope to the self Person.

foreign_keys.name: fk_schedule_revision_operation_schedule_ref_schedule
foreign_keys.semantic_reason: Many chronological revisions may target the same stable Schedule.

foreign_keys.name: fk_schedule_revision_op_expected_state_placement_state
foreign_keys.semantic_reason: Retain the exact accepted concurrency basis.

foreign_keys.name: fk_schedule_revision_op_material_state_placement_state
foreign_keys.semantic_reason: Bind replay to the immutable placement state created by this revision.

unique_constraints.name: uq_schedule_revision_operation_material_state_ref
unique_constraints.reason: A produced placement MaterialState belongs to one revision receipt.

check_constraints.name: ck_schedule_revision_operation_operation_id
check_constraints.reason: Keep operation identity canonical and bounded.

indexes.name: uq_schedule_revision_operation_material_state_ref
indexes.reason: One receipt per produced placement state.

indexes.name: ix_schedule_revision_operation_schedule_ref
indexes.reason: Operational inspection of chronological revision receipts per Schedule.

state_history.material_state_behavior: The receipt references the exact old and new schedule.placement MaterialStateRefs but is not a MaterialState.
state_history.current_binding: Acceptance requires expected_material_state_ref to equal the explicit current binding; replay returns the immutable recorded effect.
state_history.chronology: created_at is shared with the newly opened current-history episode; the prior episode is closed at that instant.
state_history.immutability_policy: Receipts are replay-only; same operation with different material intent conflicts.

lifecycle.delete_behavior: No direct runtime table privileges; downgrade fails closed while revision receipts exist.

obligations: runtime has no direct table read/write privilege
same operation id and same exact intent replays the immutable prior effect
same operation id with different intent conflicts
stale expected MaterialStateRef cannot overwrite newer current truth
one revision retains the old history episode and opens exactly one new current episode
